info.title: TenderSync API
info.description: Monitors South African eTenders, extracts bid-pack requirements and scores qualification. Data: National Treasury eTenders (PDDL). Verify in the original bid document.

get.summary: Overview page data: new matches, matched tenders closing soon, pipeline status, model cost this month (Admin only) and expiring company documents.

post.summary: Exchange email and password for an access token and a refresh token.
Rotate a refresh token. The old token is revoked; reusing it revokes the whole family.

get.summary: The authenticated user and roles.
Paged tender list with full-text search and filters.
Tender detail with buyer, documents, classification and status history.
Status transitions, releases seen and notifications sent for a tender.

post.summary: Runs the keyword prefilter and the model classification again and returns the outcome. Reviewer or Admin.

get.summary: Extracted requirements grouped by kind, each with its source document, page, quote and verify flag.

post.summary: Queues requirement extraction (and any outstanding document downloads first). Reviewer or Admin.

get.summary: The newest qualification report (can we bid?): verdict, score, findings with sources, missing items, questions for a human and the markdown with its disclaimer. 404 until a run has completed.

post.summary: Queues a qualification run for one profile (companyProfileId) or every matched profile. Needs extracted requirements (409 otherwise). Reviewer or Admin.

get.summary: Documents of a tender with their download and extraction state.
Streams the stored copy of a document. 409 when it has not been downloaded yet; the response then names the original URL.
Extracted text per page (empty until the extraction job has run).

post.summary: Queues the download and extraction of every document not yet stored. Reviewer or Admin.

get.summary: The matches inbox: matched tenders with workflow status, relevance, newest verdict and closing date, plus counts per status for the tabs.

patch.summary: Changes a match's status and notes. Dismissing needs a dismiss reason. Records a decision only; nothing is submitted (ADR-015). Reviewer or Admin.

get.summary: Bid applications, newest first. Empty in v1: applications are created from Phase 2.
Every interest category, enabled or not, ordered by code.

post.summary: Creates a category. Codes are unique (409 when taken).

put.summary: Replaces name, description, keywords, negative keywords, weight and enabled. Reclassify a tender to see the effect.

delete.summary: Deletes a category. Disabling it is the reversible alternative.

post.summary: Dry-runs the keyword prefilter against the enabled categories for a stored tender (tenderId) or free text.

get.summary: Company profiles (active ones unless includeInactive=true).
A profile with its compliance data (tax PIN masked), capabilities and document count.

put.summary: Replaces every editable section of the profile. Admin.

delete.summary: Deactivates a profile (matches and reports keep referencing it). Admin.

get.summary: The company's document library with expiry flags and the master key each entry is wrapped with.

post.summary: Uploads a document (multipart: file, type, title, expiresAt). Encrypted with a per-file key before it reaches the store. Reviewer or Admin.

get.summary: Streams the decrypted document. Every download is written to the audit log. Reviewer or Admin.

put.summary: Renames a document or changes its expiry. Reviewer or Admin.

delete.summary: Soft-deletes a document; the encrypted blob is kept. Admin.

get.summary: Messages sent (or queued) to any of the caller's preference addresses, newest first.

post.summary: Queues a test message to the caller's address on the channel; the Worker delivers it within about a minute.

get.summary: The caller's channel subscriptions.

put.summary: Replaces the caller's subscriptions: one entry per channel with address, types, enabled flag and optional quiet hours. Channels left out are removed.

get.summary: Audit log of every command, newest first.
Latest reachability, latency and schema-drift probes of the tender sources.
Background job runs, newest first, with per-run details such as ingest summaries.
Model spend: totals by day, purpose and model for a window (default 30 days), today's spend against the cap, and the latest calls.
Recurring jobs registered by the Worker: cron (SAST), queue, next and last execution, state of the last run.

post.summary: Asks the Worker to run a recurring job now (through the outbox; it starts within about a minute).

get.summary: Every account with its role, disabled flag, lockout and last sign-in.

post.summary: Creates an account with one role (Admin, Reviewer or Viewer).

put.summary: Changes display name and role, disables or re-enables (revoking sessions), optionally sets a new password. The last enabled admin cannot be demoted or disabled.

post.summary: Master-key rotation: re-wraps every company document's data key with the active key (docs/runbooks/key-rotation.md).

Bearer.description: Paste the access token from POST /api/v1/auth/login.
